# External Entity Submission Checklist

Before submitting any profile:
- Canonical name correct
- Egypt entity clearly identified
- Official website correct
- Location correct
- Logo current
- Category correct
- Services accurate
- Social links official
- Description matches entity taxonomy
- No unsupported awards or ranking claims
- No fake reviews
- No duplicate profile
- Contact details verified

After submission:
- Record profile URL
- Record status
- Record verification requirement
- Record review count
- Record last updated
- Link from official site where appropriate
